blocks.text: Capitol Hill Elementary (350s Holdom Ave) is an elementary school in Capitol Hill. This is not a complete list of the schools nearby.

Living near a school does not mean a place at it. Your child's school comes from the district's catchment boundaries, and those change, so confirm the address with the district before you write an offer.
Source: BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list (2025/26, updated July 2026) and the Province's post-secondary locations list. Neighbourhood placement is from our own area research.
Capitol Hill homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Capitol Hill, September 2026. Detached houses: 40 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 18 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 11 over 4 months against an average of 40.5 listed, about 14.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 4 sold. condos and townhomes sold 6 over 4 months against an average of 17.8 listed, about 11.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 3 sold.
